children: Centrus signed a multi-year contract to supply HALEU to Radiant, with deliveries beginning before the end of the decade and prepayments to support Centrus' domestic enrichment capacity build-out.
Signed definitive multi-year contract to supply high-assay low-enriched uranium (HALEU) to Radiant for Kaleidos microreactors.
Deliveries of HALEU are scheduled to begin prior to the end of the current decade, supporting Radiant's move toward commercial and national security deployments.
Agreement includes Radiant prepayments to Centrus to advance Centrus' domestic commercial enrichment capacity expansion.
Centrus' U.S.-origin enrichment tech provides "unobligated" HALEU usable for national security applications, strengthening domestic fuel supply chain.
